dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: Why, yes there is. I'm the new port supervisor here. But ever since I installed that cutting-edge kuuvahki conveyor belt on the docks, it's been breaking down every other day!

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: If it doesn't get jammed, then something'll come loose, and if neither of those, then it's the power supply having issues!

dialogues.speaker: Manez
dialogues.text: I thought there was something wrong with the machine I bought, so I paid a hefty sum to get a master to fix it. But he's been looking at it for three days, and he still can't tell me what the problem is!
